title: One-step tableau update
statement: Let $M$ be a finite binary Turing machine whose head positions depend only on the input length and time, let $x$ be a binary string, and let $t\in\mathbb{N}$. Applying the tableau update rule to the ideal source bits for $x$ at time $t$ yields the encoding of the machine's snapshot on $x$ at time $t$, followed by the bit indicating whether an accepting output has been emitted by that time.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite binary Turing machine
